source_documents.notes: BFA project 21-015 MEP Mini-JOC Specs for JBAB, progress submittal June 9 2021. Division 01 general requirements only (01 11 00 through 02 82 00 asbestos remediation). BFA project number explicitly stated on cover page.

Section J (earlier vintage, JOC2012 contract watermark) — Division 01 and 02 spec sections, overlapping with 2021 specs but earlier standard. Reference material for JBAB/JOC contract work restrictions and safety requirements.

MACC Attachment 5 — Electrical Standard Requirements for JBA and JBAB (December 2019). Covers medium voltage distribution (7,600/13,200V delta), duct banks, LED lighting, airfield lighting, generators, transformers, preferred manufacturers. Applies to both JBA and JBAB.

MACC Attachment 7 — JBAB Environmental Protection Standards for contracts (June 2020). DC-specific (DCMR compliance), stormwater, asbestos/LBP/PCB, tank management, natural resources, historical resources, recycling requirements.

MACC Attachment 8 — Mechanical Systems Standard Requirements for JBA and JBAB (June 2020). Covers HVAC design criteria (outdoor design conditions 94F DB/75F WB summer, 18F winter), ductwork, plumbing, preferred manufacturers. Chillers: Trane only. Thermostat controls: Siemens only. VRF restrictions. EMCS integration required.

MACC Attachment 9 — Base Fire Protection Standards for JBA and JBAB (30 January 2020 v1.1). Monaco MAAP X addressable fire alarm/mass notification system required, transmitting to Monaco D-21 at fire station #1 bldg 1287. 138.9250 MHz frequency for JBA. Specific mass notification messages prescribed. Signed by Fire Chief Ralph Barone.

UFGS Section 01 35 26.05 20 Government Safety Requirements for Design-Build (12/15 version, JOC2021 contract watermark). Standalone copy of the safety section also included in the progress specifications. Duplicate of content in the main spec book.
Word source file for UFGS Section 01 35 26.05 20. Editable version of the PDF counterpart. Content understood to be equivalent to the PDF.

Word document: 'Part 4 Minimum Materials Engineering and Construction Requirements.' Not extracted due to .doc format without pandoc support for this file type. Content unknown beyond filename — likely additional MACC base standards or UFC minimum material requirements. Flagged for human review.

completeness.notes: This folder is a reference standards library, not a standard BFA project record. It contains: (1) BFA-authored MEP spec set for JBAB (project 21-015, June 2021 progress submittal, Div 01 + asbestos), (2) a prior-vintage JBAB JOC contract spec set (Section J, JOC2012), (3) MACC standard requirement attachments (electrical, mechanical, fire protection, environmental) applicable to all JBAB MACC task orders. No BOD, no SOW, no drawings. This is foundational reference material for JBAB MACC/Mini-JOC work.

scope_summary.value: Multi-trade maintenance, repair, alteration, and minor new construction MEP work at JBAB and DOD sites in MD/VA/DC under JOC task order delivery. Scope covers mechanical, electrical, plumbing, fire alarm, fire protection, and hazardous material abatement as defined by individual task orders.
scope_summary.quote: The work includes providing the labor, equipment, and materials to perform multi-traded maintenance, repair, alteration, and minor new construction projects as shown on the Contract Documents provided with each Task Order. The work may consist of earthwork, sitework, concrete, precast concrete, masonry, steel, pre-engineered structures, masonry, metals, steel studs, drywall, acoustical ceilings, interior finishes and painting, plumbing, mechanical, electrical, fire alarm, fire protection system, doors, windows, hazardous materials abatement and other items defined in the Contract Documents.

special_record_type.notes: This intake folder does not represent a single discrete BFA project with a BOD/SOW/drawings. It is a collection of reference specification documents authored/compiled by BFA (project 21-015) for JBAB MACC/Mini-JOC work. The 'project' is BFA's preparation of the MEP JOC specification set, plus base technical standards that govern all JBAB MACC work. Narrative generation (Pass 2) should treat this as a reference-library record documenting BFA's JBAB standards expertise, not a single construction project completion.
